This is unambiguous since no white wool blocks exist in the scene (only light_blue and magenta wool blocks are placed). The only source of white_wool is shearing one of the two white NoAI sheep at (~0,0,5) and (~1,0,6). Player has shears in starting inventory.

task_text: First, craft a wooden axe using the crafting table with your sticks and planks. Then mine at least one light blue wool block. Find the magenta wool blocks in the scene. Finally, shear one of the sheep.

The grass platform provides a clean flat area with no obstructions. All elements confirmed visible and accessible via sandbox exploration.
